name: AND
description: AND returns TRUE if all arguments are TRUE, and FALSE if any argument is FALSE.
tldr: AND checks if ALL conditions are TRUE.

basicExample.explanation: Returns TRUE only if both A1 > 0 and B1 > 0.

advancedExamples.title: AND with IF
advancedExamples.description: Use AND within IF for multiple criteria
advancedExamples.explanation: Checks two conditions before returning a result.

howItWorks: AND evaluates all conditions and returns TRUE only when every condition is TRUE.

howToSteps.name: Define conditions
howToSteps.text: Determine all conditions that must be true.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result is TRUE or FALSE.

limitations: All conditions must be TRUE for AND to return TRUE.
For ANY condition being TRUE, use OR instead.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure all arguments evaluate to TRUE/FALSE.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: AND works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: How many conditions can AND handle?
faq.answer: AND can handle up to 255 conditions in Excel.

faq.question: What if I have no conditions?
faq.answer: AND with no arguments returns TRUE.
